Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 13
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the New York Times article’s publication date (Nov. 13, 1977) as the election date, despite the article explicitly stating “NEW ORLEANS, Nov. 12 — Ernest N. Morial was elected Mayor of New Orleans today.” This conflation of publication date with event date led to the wrong conclusion and propagated ambiguity, even after earlier results indicated November 12, 1977.
